correctness.rationale: The normalized derivative of the positive pooled target compartment follows by summing the frozen linear-in-target equations: it depends on the susceptible history distribution only through its response mean. Inclusion–exclusion with the triple mass t yields exactly four odd cells of mass t and four even cells of mass 1/4−t; no other constraints besides 0≤t≤1/4 remain. The product response has slope −(1−c)^3, hence its range endpoints and width are sharp. An independent rational check verified the full pair tables, eligibility with strictly positive cells in both interior distributions, and the two opposite signed normalized derivatives in the frozen example. The comparison keeps the model parameters, susceptible total, and seeded compartment identical. With at most two prior labels all cells are fixed by the given moments, so no smaller case can exhibit this ambiguity. The general moment test is also correct: lower-order observed moments span the corresponding monomials, and uniform even/odd laws on any higher-order support with a nonzero Möbius coefficient agree on all strictly lower inclusion moments while differing on the top moment. This proves the iff for all distributions, not for every individual feasible fiber.
residual_risks: The witness concerns instantaneous growth at admissible mathematical states, not historical reachability, equilibrium invasion, or later outcomes. Strict positivity is for the susceptible cells, not every model compartment.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Distributional nonidentification alone does not imply nonidentification of the specified product expectation or opposite initial signs at identical demographic and seed values. The application requires the nonzero product contrast and a strict crossing between positive feasible points, along with the lower-dimension no-alias proof. This is a bounded model-specific distinction, not a new general theory of margins or growth.

The strongest inspected analogues do not establish that model-specific conclusion.

value.rationale: The model-specific result shows that pairwise data cannot in general even certify the direction of initial change, despite a separable per-history response and absence of zero susceptible cells. The small sharp boundary identifies when complete pairwise observation does and does not suffice. It is an identifiability warning for interpreting model summaries, not a claim about actual spread or a recommendation to change it.
residual_risks: No validated inference for named pathogens, longitudinal dynamics, or reachable population histories.
